verdict.rationale: Statsig exposes a Console API (CRUD for gates/experiments/configs), an HTTP API, and a CLI that can be scripted/integrated into CI/CD, which together enable programmatic bulk operations across many feature gates, experiments, and configs — a good fit for AI-native automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of native batch/bulk-edit endpoints (e.g., bulk update many items in one call) or AI-agent-specific bulk workflows beyond the MCP server for querying data. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or documented multi-item operations in one call, hands-on/independent evidence of bulk automation at scale, and AI-native bulk-editing examples via MCP.
